summary: @servicetitan/skeleton ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods it, and then invokes it to execute `math_init.js` — a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated Bun-only bundle (rotating string/number array decoder, `_0x`-style identifiers) shipped at the tarball root. Neither `math_init.js` nor `setup.mjs` is declared in `package.json.files` (which lists only `dist`, `src/anvil2.css.css`, `src/styles.css`), and the declared main `dist/index.js` is a 34-byte file containing only a sourceMappingURL comment — the package ships no library code matching its advertised UI/CSS skeleton purpose. The homepage and devDependencies reference ServiceTitan's frontend monorepo, consistent with impersonation of the legitimate `@servicetitan/skeleton`. Installing this package triggers install-time execution of undeclared, obfuscated code under an alternate runtime, evading Node-focused inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
